name: Rice
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: half or quarter of a pound of the best quality of rice
ingredients.originalText: half or quarter of a pound of the best quality of rice

instructions.text: Put it in a saucepan with a quart of clean water and a pinch of salt
Let it boil slowly till the water is all evaporated, ensuring it does not burn
Pour in a teacupful of new milk
Stir carefully from the bottom of the saucepan so that the upper grain may go under, but do not smash it
Close the lid on your saucepan carefully down and set it on a cooler part of the fire where it will not boil
As soon as it has absorbed the added milk, serve it up with fresh new milk, adding fruit and sugar for those who like them

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Wash rice in a strainer
2. Put it in a saucepan with a quart of clean water and a pinch of salt
3. Let it boil slowly till the water is all evaporated, ensuring it does not burn
4. Pour in a teacupful of new milk
5. Stir carefully from the bottom of the saucepan so that the upper grain may go under, but do not smash it
6. Close the lid on your saucepan carefully down and set it on a cooler part of the fire where it will not boil
7. As soon as it has absorbed the added milk, serve it up with fresh new milk, adding fruit and sugar for those who like them
